_readme: The wallpapers Center offers under 'Download CTW wallpapers'. Center reads this file from raw.githubusercontent.com/enterTheVoidCode/ClawTweaksCenter/master/wallpapers/index.json and downloads each 'file' from this same folder, so adding one is a commit here and nothing else - no Center build, no release. raw.githubusercontent caches for about four minutes, so a new entry shows up a few minutes after the push. 'name' is shown under the tile and is NOT translated: these are picture names, not UI copy. Keep the files 16:10 - they are drawn behind the whole window with UniformToFill, so a different shape is cropped rather than letterboxed.
